entities.text: HIGH COURT OF HIMACHAL PRADESH, SHIMLA COPC No.613 of 2024
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
1 For the Petitioners: Mr. Sahil Thakur, Proxy counsel vice Mr. Sanjay Bhardwaj, Advocate.
For the Respondents: Mr. Anup Rattan, Advocate General with Mr. Rajan Kahol, Mr.
Vishal Panwar and Mr. B.C.Verma, Additional Advocate Generals and Mr. Ravi C h a u h a n , D e p u t y A d v o c a t e G e n e r a l , f o r t h e r e s p o n d e n t s - S t a t e .
_______________________________________________________ Sandeep Sharma, Judge(oral):
While placing on record communication dated 5.3.2025, issued under the signatures of Superintending Engineer (D-III), Office of Engineer-in-Chief, HPPWD, Nigam Vihar, Shimla, Himachal Pradesh, Mr. Vishal Panwar, learned Additional Advocate General, on instructions, states that mandate contained in the judgment alleged to have been violated stands duly implemented and in that regard, necessary direction already stands issued to the concerned Department for issuance of Notification under Section 11 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Whether the reporters of the local papers may be allowed to see the judgment?

2. Having perused the aforesaid communication, which is taken on record, this Court finds that Department concerned has decided to implement the judgment alleged to have been violated,
subject to final outcome of LPA and in that regard, process already stands initiated for issuance of Notification under Section 11 of the Act.
3.
Consequently, in view of the above, nothing remains to be adjudicated in the instant proceedings and accordingly same are closed.
Notices issued to the respondents are hereby discharged.

However,
respondents are directed to complete the acquisition proceedings within a period of four months.

Petitioners are at liberty to get the present proceedings revived in case respondents fail to do the needful within the time stipulated by this Court, so that appropriate action, in accordance with law _______________________________________________________ vs Onkar Chand Sharma & Others on 6 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/117382455/
1 is taken against the erring officials.
(Sandeep Sharma), Judge March 06,2025 (shankar)
